overview: This enum identifies the battle effect that an equipment item applies.

None.simple: This equipment effect slot is empty.
None.technical: The effect row constructor sets EffectType to None. No gameplay query selects this value in the reconstructed source, so any behavior beyond its default role is unresolved.

HitPointMax.technical: GamePvE_CalcHitPoint sums EffectValue[0] over this type in the character equipment list. The sum is in health points and is added to scaled base health before the final minimum of one health point.

HitPointMaxAlly.simple: Raises the health limit of the wearer's team.
HitPointMaxAlly.technical: GamePvE_CalcHitPoint scans the combined equipment list and takes the largest EffectValue[0] in health points. That amount is added to the character's own HitPointMax equipment sum.

HitPointMaxEnemy.simple: Lowers enemy health limits in PvE.
HitPointMaxEnemy.technical: GamePvE_CalcMissionCharacterHitPoint sums EffectValue[0] over the combined equipment list and adds the signed health point total to mission character health. The result is clamped to at least one health point.

HitPointWhenJustGuard.simple: Can restore health after a perfect guard.
HitPointWhenJustGuard.technical: ApplyJustGuardHitPointGain rolls EffectValue[0] as an integer percentage and adds EffectValue[1] health points on success. Each matching equipment row rolls separately.

HitPointWhenJustGuardAlly.simple: Can restore health for teammates after a perfect guard.
HitPointWhenJustGuardAlly.technical: GetHitPointWhenJustGuardAllyFromEquipment uses GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectValue, which rolls EffectValue[0] and sums EffectValue[1] health points on success. The battle system adds that amount to every living teammate of the guarding character.

HitPointWhenSendDamage.simple: Restores health in proportion to damage dealt.
HitPointWhenSendDamage.technical: GetHitPointWhenSendDamageRate sums EffectValue[0] as a damage to health ratio. Damage application multiplies the ratio by the dealt damage and adds the result to current health.

HitPointWhenSendDamageAlly.simple: Heals teammates in proportion to damage the wearer deals.
HitPointWhenSendDamageAlly.technical: GetHitPointWhenSendDamageAllyValue sums EffectValue[0] as a damage to health ratio. The battle system multiplies that ratio by each attacker's accumulated positive damage and adds the result to every living teammate.

HitPointWithTime.technical: GetHitPointWithTimeValue adds the sum of EffectValue[0] as health points per second. The status tick multiplies that value by DeltaTime while the character is alive.

HitPointWithTimeAlly.technical: FStudioBattleSystem380 takes the largest EffectValue[0] across this type in the combined equipment list for team A and treats it as health points per second. Each character adds that ally value to personal regeneration and the status tick applies it over DeltaTime.

HitPointWithTimeOnce.simple: Starts a temporary health regeneration effect.
HitPointWithTimeOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. When SetHitPoint changes health and the resulting health ratio is at or below EffectValue[0], with no recorded use at the effect slot, the row Id_BuffDebuff is applied to the wearer. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies regeneration strength and duration.

HitPointWithTimeOnceAlly.simple: Starts temporary health regeneration for teammates.
HitPointWithTimeOnceAlly.technical: This is a one-shot type. The health ratio gate and item use gate add the row Id_BuffDebuff to the ally list. SetHitPoint applies that buff to every living teammate on the wearer's team.

HitPointWithTimeOnceEnemy.simple: Starts temporary health loss for rivals.
HitPointWithTimeOnceEnemy.technical: This is a one-shot type. The health ratio gate and item use gate add the row Id_BuffDebuff to the rival list. SetHitPoint applies that buff to every living member of the opposing team.

HitPointOnce.simple: Restores a fixed amount of health at low health.
HitPointOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. The health ratio gate uses EffectValue[0] and the item use gate uses the flat effect slot. On success the row adds EffectValue[1] health points directly and the final health value is clamped.

DashGaugeMax.technical: GameEquipment_SumEffectRate adds EffectValue[0] minus one to the Dash Gauge maximum rate. The status controller multiplies that rate by DashGaugeMaxValue when initializing and capping the gauge.

DashGaugeMaxWithHitPointRate.simple: Raises maximum Dash Gauge at low health.
DashGaugeMaxWithHitPointRate.technical: GetDashGaugeMaxRate calls GameEquipment_SumEffectRateAtValue with the current health ratio and bAtLeast false. Rows apply when the health ratio is at or below EffectValue[0], and EffectValue[1] minus one is added to the maximum rate.

DashGaugeMaxEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the enemy Dash Gauge maximum rate.

DashGaugeConsume.simple: Reduces Dash Gauge spent while dashing.
DashGaugeConsume.technical: GetDashGaugeConsumeRateFromEffects adds EffectValue[0] minus one to a multiplier that starts at one. The resulting rate multiplies action dash costs at dash start and during ongoing dashes.

DashGaugeRecover.technical: GetDashGaugeRecoverRate adds the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas to a base rate of one and clamps the result to zero or higher. Recovery uses this rate with the action dash GaugeRecover value.

DashGaugeRecoverEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type. A character multiplies personal recovery by that enemy rate.

DashGaugeRecoverOnce.simple: Temporarily speeds up Dash Gauge recovery.
DashGaugeRecoverOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. The health ratio gate and item use gate add the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. SetHitPoint applies that buff to the wearer when still alive.

DashGaugeOnce.simple: Instantly refills part of the Dash Gauge.
DashGaugeOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. On a successful health ratio and item use gate, SetDashGauge receives the current gauge plus maximum gauge multiplied by EffectValue[1]. The second value is therefore a fraction of the maximum gauge.

DashGaugeUnlimitedOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row controls the duration of unlimited dashing.

DashGaugeNotRecoverWhenSendDamage.simple: Temporarily stops enemy Dash Gauge recovery after a hit.
DashGaugeNotRecoverWhenSendDamage.technical: CollectAttackBuffDebuffIds collects the row Id_BuffDebuff when dealt damage is greater than zero. The applied BuffDebuff row defines the recovery lockout duration.

DashGaugeWhenSendDamage.simple: Reduces an enemy Dash Gauge when the wearer deals damage.
DashGaugeWhenSendDamage.technical: GetDashGaugeWhenSendDamage returns the summed EffectValue[0] only when damage is greater than zero. Damage handling multiplies that signed value by the receiving character's maximum Dash Gauge and adds it before the gauge is capped.

ReceiveDamage.technical: GetReceiveDamageRate adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas to the incoming damage rate. Each matching row contributes from its first effect value with one as the neutral rate.

ReceiveDamageWithProb.technical: GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectRate rolls EffectValue[0] as an integer percentage for each matching row. A successful roll adds EffectValue[1] minus one to the incoming damage rate.

ReceiveDamageWithProbAlly.technical: For team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 uses GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectRate for this type and returns one plus the successful EffectValue[1] minus one deltas as the ally incoming damage rate.

AttackWithDashGaugeRecover.simple: Weakens enemy Dash Gauge recovery after a hit.
AttackWithDashGaugeRecover.technical: CollectAttackBuffDebuffIds collects the row Id_BuffDebuff whenever a damage row is present. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies the enemy recovery penalty and duration.

AttackWithDashDisabled.simple: Stops enemies from dashing after a hit.
AttackWithDashDisabled.technical: CollectAttackBuffDebuffIds collects the row Id_BuffDebuff whenever a damage row is present. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies the dash disabled duration.

NormalAttackWithMoveSlow.simple: Sometimes slows enemies with normal attacks.
NormalAttackWithMoveSlow.technical: CollectAttackBuffDebuffIds applies this type only when the damage row AttackType is NormalAttack. GameEquipment_RollBuffDebuffIdsOfType rolls EffectValue[0] and appends Id_BuffDebuff on success.

DomainExpansionCastingTime.technical: Domain Expansion casting functions sum EffectValue[0] in seconds and add it to the domain row CastingTime. The result is clamped to zero or higher before it is used as casting time or casting ratio denominator.

SendSpecialTagComboDamage.simple: Adds flat damage to Joint Attacks.
SendSpecialTagComboDamage.technical: GetSpecialTagComboDamageBonus returns zero unless the team is team A and the damage row AttackType is SpecialTagCombo. It then sums EffectValue[0] damage points across all equipment rows of this type.

SendSpecialTagComboDamageWithHitPointRat.simple: Adds Joint Attack damage at low health.
SendSpecialTagComboDamageWithHitPointRat.technical: For each character's item list, GameEquipment_SumEffectValueAtValue applies rows where the health ratio is at or below EffectValue[0] and sums EffectValue[1] damage points. FStudioBattleSystem380 takes the largest qualifying character total and adds it to the flat Joint Attack bonus.

ReceiveDamageZeroWhenAttack.technical: GameEquipment_HasRolledEffect rolls EffectValue[0] for each matching row. If any roll succeeds, GetReceiveDamageRate sets the entire incoming damage rate to zero.

ReceiveDamageWithDashGauseUnlimited.simple: Temporarily stops Dash Gauge use after taking a hit.
ReceiveDamageWithDashGauseUnlimited.technical: OnDamageReceivedDashGauge collects the row Id_BuffDebuff for this type while the receiving character is alive. Every resolved BuffDebuff row is applied to that character.

ReceiveDamageOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies the damage reduction and duration.

CursedEnergyRecover.technical: GetCursedEnergyRecoverRate adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas to the Cursed Energy recovery rate and clamps the final rate to zero or higher.

CursedEnergyRecoverWhenDebuff.simple: Speeds up Cursed Energy recovery while debuffed.
CursedEnergyRecoverWhenDebuff.technical: The status controller counts active debuffs and calls GameEquipment_SumEffectRateAtValue with bAtLeast true. Rows apply when the debuff count is at or above EffectValue[0] and EffectValue[1] minus one is added to recovery.

CursedEnergyRecoverEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type. A character multiplies personal recovery by that enemy rate.

CursedEnergyWhenDash.simple: Sometimes restores Cursed Energy when dashing.
CursedEnergyWhenDash.technical: ConsumeDashGaugeBegin rolls EffectValue[0] for each matching row and adds successful EffectValue[1] values as Cursed Energy points at dash start. It applies once at dash start.

CursedEnergyWhenNormalAttack.simple: Sometimes restores Cursed Energy on normal attacks.
CursedEnergyWhenNormalAttack.technical: OnDamageDealt applies this type only when the damage row AttackType is NormalAttack. A successful EffectValue[0] roll adds EffectValue[1] Cursed Energy points.

CursedEnergyWhenKill.simple: Sometimes fully restores Cursed Energy on a knockout.
CursedEnergyWhenKill.technical: GetKillCursedEnergy uses GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectValue so EffectValue[0] is the roll chance. The successful EffectValue[1] is multiplied by CursedEnergyMax, making it a fraction of the maximum gauge.

CursedEnergyWhenCursedEnergyAttackEnemy.simple: Sometimes drains rival Cursed Energy with Cursed Energy attacks.
CursedEnergyWhenCursedEnergyAttackEnemy.technical: GetCursedEnergyWhenAttackEnemyValue applies this type only when the damage row AttackType is CursedEnergyAttack_1 or CursedEnergyAttack_2. A successful EffectValue[0] roll contributes its signed EffectValue[1].

CursedEnergyWhenAttackEnemy.simple: Sometimes drains rival Cursed Energy when attacks land.
CursedEnergyWhenAttackEnemy.technical: GetCursedEnergyWhenAttackEnemyValue adds the rolled EffectValue[1] for this type whenever a damage row exists. It also applies to attack types outside the Cursed Energy attack specific contribution.

CursedEnergyOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds EffectValue[1] directly to current Cursed Energy.

CursedEnergyOnceEnemy.technical: This is a one-shot type. For each living rival, the reconstructed loop applies each rival's maximum Cursed Energy multiplied by EffectValue[1]. Negative values drain energy. The change repeats once for each collected rival buff ID.

CursedEnergyExp.technical: GetCursedEnergyExpRate adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas to the Cursed Energy experience rate. The final rate is clamped to zero or higher.

CursedEnergyExpEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the enemy Cursed Energy experience rate.

CursedEnergyExpWhenDash.simple: Sometimes grants extra Cursed Energy gain during a dash.
CursedEnergyExpWhenDash.technical: ConsumeDashGaugeBegin rolls EffectValue[0] for this type at dash start and passes successful EffectValue[1] values to AddCursedEnergyExp.

CursedEnergyExpWhenAttack.simple: Sometimes grants extra Cursed Energy gain when attacks land.
CursedEnergyExpWhenAttack.technical: OnDamageDealt computes standard Cursed Energy experience from damage and then adds successful EffectValue[1] values from this type before calling AddCursedEnergyExp.

CursedEnergyExpWhenSendGuard.simple: Sometimes grants extra Cursed Energy gain when an attack is guarded.
CursedEnergyExpWhenSendGuard.technical: AddSendGuardCursedEnergyExp rolls EffectValue[0] for this type and passes successful EffectValue[1] values to AddCursedEnergyExp.

CursedEnergyExpWhenSendGuardBreak.simple: Grants extra Cursed Energy gain when an enemy guard breaks.
CursedEnergyExpWhenSendGuardBreak.technical: AddSendGuardBreakCursedEnergyExp uses GameEquipment_SumEffectValue for this type, so EffectValue[0] is a flat experience amount and no chance roll is performed.

CursedEnergyExpWhenLinkCombo.simple: Sometimes grants extra Cursed Energy gain on a Cooperation Bonus.
CursedEnergyExpWhenLinkCombo.technical: AddLinkComboCursedEnergy computes the normal link combo gain and adds successful EffectValue[1] values from this type before setting the Cursed Energy gauge.

CursedEnergyExpOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies the gain multiplier and duration.

CursedEnergyExpOnceEnemy.simple: Temporarily stops rival Cursed Energy gain.
CursedEnergyExpOnceEnemy.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the rival list, which SetHitPoint applies to every living rival.

SendGuardDurabilityDamage.technical: GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageRate begins at one and adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as a general outgoing guard durability damage multiplier.

SendNormalAttackGuardDurabilityDamage.simple: Increases guard damage from normal attacks.
SendNormalAttackGuardDurabilityDamage.technical: GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageRate adds this type only when the damage row AttackType is NormalAttack. EffectValue[0] minus one is added to the outgoing guard damage multiplier.

SendCursedEnergyAttackGuardDurabilityDam.simple: Increases guard damage from Cursed Energy attacks.
SendCursedEnergyAttackGuardDurabilityDam.technical: GetSendGuardDurabilityDamageRate adds this type only when the damage row AttackType is CursedEnergyAttack_1 or CursedEnergyAttack_2. EffectValue[0] minus one is added to the outgoing guard damage multiplier.

GuardDurabilityMax.technical: GetGuardDurabilityMaxRate adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type to the guard durability maximum rate and clamps the final rate to zero or higher.

GuardDurabilityMaxWithForceGauge.simple: Raises guard value when the team gauge is low.
GuardDurabilityMaxWithForceGauge.technical: GetGuardDurabilityMaxRate reads the character's team stock and uses GameEquipment_SumEffectRateAtValue with bAtLeast false. Rows apply when stock is at or below EffectValue[0] and EffectValue[1] minus one is added to the guard maximum rate.

GuardDurabilityMaxAlly.technical: For team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 uses GameEquipment_SumEffectRate with the max flag. It returns one plus the largest EffectValue[0] minus one delta as the ally guard durability maximum rate.

GuardDurabilityMaxEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the enemy guard durability maximum rate.

SendAttackDamage.technical: GetSendAttackDamageRate adds summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type to the outgoing damage rate. The completed rate is clamped to at least one hundredth.

SendAttackDamageWithHitPointRate.simple: Increases damage dealt at low health.
SendAttackDamageWithHitPointRate.technical: GetSendAttackDamageRate calls GameEquipment_SumEffectRateAtValue with the current health ratio and bAtLeast false. Rows apply when the ratio is at or below EffectValue[0] and EffectValue[1] minus one is added to outgoing damage.

SendAttackDamageEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the enemy outgoing damage rate.

SendAttackDamageOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row supplies the damage multiplier and duration.

SendAttackDamageOnceEnemy.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the rival list, which SetHitPoint applies to every living rival.

LinkComboCursedEnergyExpOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row controls the link combo gain multiplier and duration.

MoveSpeedEnemy.technical: For teams other than team A, FStudioBattleSystem380 returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the enemy movement speed rate.

StaggerWhenAttackEnemy.simple: Can make enemies stumble when their attacks hit.
StaggerWhenAttackEnemy.technical: For a character on a team other than team A, IsUnderItemEffectPenalty calls GameEquipment_HasRolledEffect for this type. A successful EffectValue[0] roll on an attack action replaces the requested action with the item effect penalty action.

SuperArmorOnce.technical: This is a one-shot type. A successful health ratio and item use gate adds the row Id_BuffDebuff to the self list. The linked BuffDebuff row controls the super armor duration.

StepDistance.technical: GetStepDistanceRate returns one plus the summed EffectValue[0] minus one deltas from this type as the step distance multiplier.

Invalid.simple: Reserved marker for an invalid equipment effect.
Invalid.technical: The header declares this terminal value explicitly as 255. No traced consumer or supplied effect row uses Invalid, so runtime behavior is unresolved.

notes: All matching equipment rows are collected by exact EffectType and are appended without deduplication. A missing Item row, EquipmentItem row, or effect row contributes nothing.
GameEquipment_SumEffectValue sums EffectValue[0] and can optionally return the largest value. GameEquipment_SumEffectRate treats one as neutral and sums EffectValue[0] minus one.
Chance helpers roll stream two with static_cast<int32>(EffectValue[0] * 100.0f) against RandRange(0, 100), so the percentage is truncated and both endpoints succeed.
GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectRate adds EffectValue[1] minus one only after a successful chance roll. GameEquipment_SumRolledEffectValue adds EffectValue[1] only after a successful chance roll.

GameEquipment_SumEffectRateAtValue compares the caller value with EffectValue[0], then adds EffectValue[1] minus one. With the at least flag off, the row applies when the caller value is at or below the threshold.
GameEquipment_SumEffectValueAtValue uses the same threshold comparison and sums EffectValue[1] as a flat amount.

The one-shot switch checks the health ratio after SetHitPoint changes health and requires the effect slot use count to be zero. Buff backed types route Id_BuffDebuff to self, allies, or rivals. Direct value types consume EffectValue[1]. Extras are cleared and consumed after their one-shot effect applies.
Several effects target a team through FStudioBattleSystem380. Team A values describe the player side, and non team A values describe the opposing side.
Invalid is declared as a sentinel and has no traced consumer. None is the row constructor default and has no traced gameplay query.
